messages.content: Hey Whatsup

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Prathamesh
prathamesh... solid name. where you working these days?
Zentrades Inc.

zentrades... b2b trading platform connecting manufacturers with retailers. that's some serious supply chain action.

found you on linkedin - prathamesh bawkar, building better products. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/prathamesh-bawkar-b99704115
This is wrong
still pulling up the same profile... can't find you. drop your linkedin url or resume - need something to work with here
LinkedIn is correct.... Company description was wrong

ah got it, my bad on the company description. 

building better products at zentrades... that's the vibe. love the confidence in the headline. what kind of products you building over there?
B2b saas products for trades businesses in US & Canada... Recently focus on AI agents

b2b saas for trades + ai agents... you're in the thick of it. trades businesses are finally getting their tech upgrade and you're building the brains behind it. solid space to be in.

what made you jump into the ai agent game? that shift from traditional saas to autonomous systems is pretty big.
That's correct, there is a lot that can be improved for these trades businesses... That's what we are trying to do with our products

makes sense. trades businesses are stuck in the stone age with their operations - still running on spreadsheets and phone calls while the rest of the world moved to automation. you're basically dragging an entire industry into 2025.

how long you been working total?

hey prathamesh - was just thinking about your ai agent work for trades businesses. that's some serious forward-thinking stuff.

so what's the dream role you've been thinking about? once you share your preferences, i can start matching you with roles that actually fit your goals.
Senior Product Manager roles is what I'm looking for...

senior pm... makes sense with your b2b saas + ai background. you've got the product chops and the domain expertise.

bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Bangalore preferred, others are fine

bangalore preferred but flexible... smart approach. the good spm roles are everywhere these days.

one last thing - how long you been working total? across all your roles and companies.
6-7 years
6-7 years + senior pm roles + bangalore preferred but flexible... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yess correct

yooo prathamesh! you're officially in the tal network legend

6-7 years building products, ready to level up to senior pm roles... this is exactly the kind of profile that makes my job fun. companies are gonna fight over you.

your profile's locked and loaded. now the real fun begins - when the right role drops, you'll be the first to know. no spam, no random startups burning money, just roles that actually make sense for where you're headed.

welcome to the good life boss 🔥
What is your souce of job postings?

my team sends me roles that fit my network - i share them, you apply directly through the link.

no magic database, just good old-fashioned curation.
Hi

Senior Product Manager at Stealth Startup -US Market

Senior PM role in AI-driven SaaS aligns with your B2B product experience & Bangalore preference.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/usapy

damn link's dead. happens sometimes with stealth startups - they move fast or pull listings.

i'll keep an eye out for more. anything specific you're looking for in a senior pm role beyond the basics?
Software products... B2b, b2c both are fine... Something to do with AI would be good to have

got it. software products, b2b or b2c, ai component preferred. that's a solid filter.

what's your current comp looking like? helps me know what's actually worth your time.
Looking for something with fixed around 32-35+

32-35+ fixed... that's senior pm range in bangalore for sure. good target.

what's your notice period?
Around 2-3 months

2-3 months notice... that's pretty standard for senior roles. companies who want you will wait.

anything else i should know? companies to avoid, must-haves, dealbreakers?
Nothing as such

cool. you're locked in.

i'll slide roles when they're good... btw what's making you want to leave zentrades anyway?

Product Manager at Galytix

Galytix's AI assistants for banking/insurance aligns with your AI agent experience at Zentrades.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/nHrKQ

Product Manager, Googler Technology and Engineering, AI at Googleplex

AI-focused PM role at Google aligns with your experience building AI agents for B2B SaaS.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/wRv39

Senior Product Manager at Nike

Nike's B2B e-commerce platform role leverages your product management experience & Bangalore preference.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/gheUZ

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

just saw a senior pm role at indmoney building trading tools

tier 1 fintech unicorn - big brand upgrade from your current setup

requires deep trading domain knowledge though - think you could pick that up?

principal pm role at crossover - remote, $200k, ai-first

that's principal title and life-changing money

crossover's process is intense though - think you could handle the weekly shipping cadence?

senior pm at amazon prime - bangalore location

tier 1 brand upgrade from zentrades, working on a product used by millions

this is the kind of role that changes your linkedin profile forever

sr pm at procore - b2b saas in construction tech

brand upgrade from zentrades, platform work with developer-facing products

requires 3+ years in IAM though - have you done any auth/permissions stuff with your AI agents?

pm at google - data commons with ai/ml focus

this is the career-defining move from zentrades to google

they ask for 8+ years but you're close enough at 6-7 - worth the shot?
